notes:
Your sources, everywhere.

Picking a main source used to just change the pills. Now it actually runs the app: Popular and Latest on Home, in Browse and in Stories all come from the site YOU chose — real feeds pulled from Weeb Central, MangaPill, MangaKatana, Asura Scans, Royal Road, Wattpad, Daisy Novel, findnovel and Gutenberg — and each shelf says whose it is.

Comics and books get their own home site (Settings › Your sources), because they're different libraries.

Open a series and it comes from your site first. Anything you're already reading stays exactly where you left it, and if a title isn't on your site the switcher is right there.

Books also gained a Popular/Latest toggle. Fixed: a junk entry that could appear in MangaKatana search results.
